input.textExcerpt:
Document: assistance-brochure.pdf
Cancellation cost insurance and Assistance for persons. Cancellation cost insurance covers you for unforeseen events occurring before your departure that make it impossible for you to set off on your journey. Assistance for persons provides insurance to cover you if anything happens while you're travelling. Insured events
• Illness, accident or death
• Loss of employment
• Breakdown/delay of public transport
• Breakdown of the vehicle or taxi you are travelling in
• Damage to your property at home
• Incidents occurring en route to or after arrival at your dest

Document: assistance-brochure.pdf
Helvetia Assistance. Entirely according to your needs. Our Assistance insur- ance consists of four components you can combine individually. Cancellation cost insurance Cancellation cost insurance covers you for unforeseen events occurring before your departure that make it impossible for you to set off on your journey. Assistance for persons Assistance for persons provides insurance to cover you if anything happens while you're travelling. 1 2 2/8  |  Helvetia Assistance – product information sheet
